summary: Frontend-only testing of Meals module: (1) Analytics 'All' preset bugfix and (2) new 'Compare items' tab. Both work as intended.

issues: Benign console warnings from Recharts: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' emitted repeatedly. Root cause: ResponsiveContainer briefly measures 0-size when the chart is conditionally rendered inside a re-flowing layout (post totals cards). Not user-visible but noisy. Consider guarding <ResponsiveContainer> or setting minWidth={0} minHeight={undefined}.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts width/height -1 warnings on Compare tab by wrapping ResponsiveContainer with minHeight/minWidth or lazy-mounting only when chartRows are ready.
critical_code_review_comments: MealCompareTab.jsx correctly wires state, empty state, presets, custom inputs and metric toggle with proper data-testids.
Consumption ₹ valued at per-item avg purchase rate is reflected (e.g. Chicken+Egg 90d shows Consumed ₹2,690.28 non-zero).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on /admin/meals-report. Analytics 'All' preset window clamped to 12 months (Fri 12/09/25 → Fri 11/09/26), no 'Range too large' toast. Compare tab: 138 pantry items, empty state shows compare-empty; picking Chicken+Egg (90d default) shows Purchased 951.6 units / Consumed 113.0 units (QTY) and ₹66,060.00 / ₹2,690.28 (Amount ₹). All presets 30/90/365/custom work; custom reveals compare-from & compare-to. Clear button resets picker to 0 and shows empty state. Search 'chicken' filters to 1 item.
